dependencies.underlying_score_basis: Final editorial decision October 16: 4.0, reconciled with the canonical internal report and generated index, below frxUSD's 4.5 ceiling. This departs from equal-not-notch pass-through convention because sfrxUSD is a strategy wrapper, not a pure holder of frxUSD: 60.17% lending claims, 19.88% external LP legs, Aave V4 42.80%, reflexive Fraxlend own-token collateral and operator-owned exit pools create additional correlated, concentrated venue/custody dependencies. Named strategies are partially substitutable, so no automatic penalty per protocol or hop. The near-wholly protocol-dependent 4.0 anchor better fits the combined set than tying parent 4.5; the parent ceiling itself retains unanchored dominant upstream reports. Asset-loss/valuation risk is scored in Backing; mutable PPS/admin is scored in Contract, not charged again here.
